WITH source_sums AS (
  SELECT 
    source,
    SUM(amount) as source_sum
  FROM income
  WHERE source IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY source
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(source_sum) as total 
  FROM source_sums
),
with_total AS (
  SELECT 
    s.source_sum,
    t.total,
    CAST(s.source_sum AS FLOAT) / t.total as ratio
  FROM source_sums s
  CROSS JOIN total_sum t
  WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL
),
avg_source_sum AS (
  SELECT AVG(source_sum) as avg_sum 
  FROM with_total
),
filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    w.source_sum,
    w.ratio,
    a.avg_sum
  FROM with_total w
  CROSS JOIN avg_source_sum a
  WHERE a.avg_sum IS NOT NULL
    AND w.source_sum > a.avg_sum
)
SELECT 
  AVG(source_sum),
  AVG(ratio),
  AVG(source_sum - avg_sum)
FROM filtered_rows
